summary: Bathroom is clean and modern, but loose mat and sharp vanity edges pose slip and impact hazards.

hazards.title: Unsecured bath mat
hazards.detail: Lightweight cloth mat on smooth tile can slip underfoot or bunch up, causing a fall.
fixSteps: Place a non-skid rubber backing pad beneath the fabric mat.
Alternatively replace it with an anti-slip silicone bath mat.

hazards.title: Sharp floating vanity corners
hazards.detail: Rigid low-height vanity corners pose impact injury risk for young children.
fixSteps: Attach clear soft silicone corner guards to exterior vanity corners.
Ensure protectors are securely taped with strong adhesive.

hazards.title: Accessible toilet lid
hazards.detail: Unlatched toilet lid presents drowning and pinching risks for small toddlers.
fixSteps: Install a child safety strap lock across the toilet lid.
Keep bathroom door closed when small children are unsupervised.
